rationale: The opening turn was weak: it wrongly floated 'a temperature sensor fault' as a typical E011 meaning, asked the customer to 'press each button individually' on a touch panel that was rejecting input, and hinted at looking at 'internal wiring' as a next step. Once the customer volunteered the wet-cleaning detail, the assistant correctly attributed E011 to moisture on the touch controls and gave a safe power-cycle instruction at the cooker switch (though it did not explicitly say to dry the panel first). The fault cleared, no part was pushed, no evidence was invented, and the prevention advice was sensible, so the homeowner was well served overall despite the shaky start.
